name: 5-9 Brims
description: The 5-9 Brims (South Side Brims) are a Blood-affiliated gang based in the Lincoln Park area of San Diego, California. They are also known as the Central City Gangsters and are one of several Blood sets operating in the San Diego area.

sources.title: How a San Diego Community Partnered With Law Enforcement to Defeat a Street Gang - KPBS
